notes: Electrothermal v1: the simplest loss source. 12 V across 10 ohm dissipates P = V^2/R = 14.4 W, constant from the operating point on; the resistor's current is 1.2 A. The thermal layer (tools/conformance/fixtures/thermal-heater.thermal.json) routes it to one lumped body; this file checks only the electrical side.
